Name: Metro Caring Fresh Foods Market
What to bring: Appointment recommended. Book on the website or call.
Notes: Free grocery store, open to anyone. Closed the first Thursday of each month. Also closed Nov 5, Nov 26, Dec 3, and Dec 31.

Name: SAME Cafe
Notes: Pay what you can, volunteer your time, or bring produce in exchange for a meal. Closed on federal holidays.

Name: Hunger Free Colorado Food Resource Hotline
Notes: Free phone line for all of Colorado. Help finding food near you and applying for SNAP (food stamps). Over 150 languages. Messages left after hours are returned the next business day.

Name: Denver Human Services: SNAP (food stamps) help
Notes: Staff can help you apply for SNAP by phone, or mail you a paper application. You can also apply online at Colorado PEAK.

Name: Integrated Family Community Services (IFCS) Food Market
Notes: Schedules posted online do not agree. Please call to confirm days and hours.

Name: Community Table (Arvada Community Food Bank)
Notes: May be moving to 4600 W 60th Ave in Arvada. Call before you go.

Name: Denver Rescue Mission Lawrence Street Community Center
Notes: Day center with meals, drinking water, and restrooms for people experiencing homelessness.

Name: Denver Inner City Parish Food Pantry
What to bring: Appointment needed to shop: book in the Plentiful app, text FOOD to 726-879, or call. No ID required.
Notes: New visitors can walk in Mon-Fri 9am-2pm for a one-time emergency food box. Friday 10am-1pm may also be open; call to check. Closed Nov 25-29.

Name: Bienvenidos Food Bank
Hours: Nov-Dec: 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Thursdays 10am-noon and 3:30-5:30pm. Jan-Oct: 1st, 2nd, and 4th Thursdays.
What to bring: ID or proof of address if you have it. A box, bag, or wheeled cart.
Notes: Drop-in, no appointment. Nov 5 and Nov 12: afternoon only (3:30-5:30pm). Need accommodations? Call or tell staff at the front. Closed most major holidays.

Name: Catholic Charities Little Flower Assistance Center
Hours: Mon and Wed 9:30am-3pm. Also Thu or Fri (the website lists both); call to check.
What to bring: Photo ID and proof of address for each adult. For each child: birth certificate, school ID, or immunization record.
Notes: Serves Aurora and Denver zip codes 80231, 80239, and 80249. Senior food program on the 2nd Monday of each month.

Name: Jewish Family Service Denver Food Pantry
What to bring: ID and proof of address. Income limits apply.
Notes: Open to everyone facing hunger. Check in from home starting 9am: text Shop to 833-340-1096. Serves up to 130 households a day. Visit up to twice a month. Register before your first visit.

Name: Senior Support Services (day center for seniors)
What to bring: New members do an intake Mon-Thu 9am-1pm.
Notes: Day center for seniors, including seniors experiencing homelessness. Membership is free; call to confirm meal costs.

Name: The Action Center Free Food Market
What to bring: No ID or paperwork required. Appointment needed for the grocery market.
Notes: Everyone is welcome. Appointments fill up quickly; a few same-day spots are given by lottery, and pre-packed grocery bags are available for urgent needs. Closed Wednesdays and weekends.

Name: Belmar Food Bank (Belmar Church)
What to bring: Photo ID requested but not required.
Notes: Drive-up. No pre-qualifiers, all are welcome, and everything is free.

Name: Shepherd's Pantry (River Church)
Notes: Food boxes plus a free hot breakfast. Address is the church's; call to confirm the pantry is there.

Name: EChO Food Pantry (Evergreen Christian Outreach)
What to bring: Photo ID. Proof of income is not required. Appointment needed to become a client.
Notes: Serves mountain communities including Evergreen, Conifer, Bailey, Pine, and Idaho Springs (Golden and Morrison only west of C-470). Set up like a small grocery store. New clients can shop the same day after registering.

Name: Ralston Creek Church Food Pantry
Notes: All are welcome, with no requirements or restrictions. Also open Saturdays at Revive Church (see separate listing).

Name: Ralston Creek Food Pantry at Revive Church
Notes: Run by Ralston Creek Church. All are welcome, with no requirements or restrictions.

Name: Golden Pantry & Thrift
Notes: For people in Golden. Open only to accepted clients; see the website for how to become one. Closed most holidays.

Name: Broomfield FISH Marketplace
Notes: Serves Broomfield County. Closed Thursdays. Closed Nov 26 and 27.

Name: Food Connect Colorado
What to bring: Appointment needed on Wednesdays; Saturdays are walk-in.
Notes: Free food market where you choose your own groceries. No income requirements. Closes when Aurora Public Schools close for weather. The street address comes from a directory; check the website before you go.

Name: The Gathering Place
Hours: Day center Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 8:30am-5pm; Tue 8:30am-1:30pm
Notes: Day center for women, gender-diverse people, and children facing homelessness or instability. Programs are free for members. Call to ask about meals and food.

Name: Volunteers of America Mission Community Center
Notes: Family center at 29th and Lawrence. Emergency pantry boxes and family-style dinners once a week. Call for days and times.

Name: Aurora Interchurch Task Force
Notes: For Aurora residents only. May need an appointment. Directory listings disagree on hours, so call first.

Name: Growing Home Food Pantry
Notes: In the Park Centre office building on 72nd Ave between Lowell and Irving. Hours come from a directory, not the pantry itself. Call to confirm before you go.

Name: FISH of Westminster (Westminster Presbyterian Church)
Hours: Directories list Mon, Wed, Thu 2:45-3:15pm and Tue 5:30-6pm
Notes: Walk-ins accepted. Directory listings disagree on hours, so call first.

Name: FISH Food Bank of Commerce City
Notes: Walk-ins accepted. Hours come from a directory, not the pantry itself. Call to confirm before you go.

Name: Open Arms Food Bank
Notes: At the back of the Church For All Nations building, behind McDonald's. Walk-ins accepted. Directory listings disagree on times, so call first.

Name: Love INC of Littleton Food Pantry
Notes: Walk-ins accepted. Directories list more than one address; call the helpline (303-794-LOVE) before you go.

Name: Waterstone Food Pantry
Notes: Partner of Food Bank of the Rockies. Hours come from a directory, not the pantry itself. Call to confirm before you go.

Name: Salvation Army West Alameda (Denver)
Notes: Southwest Denver. Hours come from a directory, not the pantry itself. Call to confirm before you go.

Name: IFCS Fresh Thanks (Thanksgiving food boxes)
Notes: EXAMPLE ROW, NOT LIVE. Fill in the address, Event date, and hours once IFCS announces 2026 details, then change Active to Y.
